name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Solve MaxCut on the graph
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Solve MaxCut on the graph [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3), (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3), (2, 4)] with QAOA (p=2) in PennyLane: build cost/mixer layers manually, optimize with AdamOptimizer, and print the most probable bitstring and its cut value. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
